next_step: Run end-to-end POC (10M docs) on Dedicated; measure p99 latency + cost per query; schedule reranker tuning workshop
notes:
Summary:
- QuillStream runs archival footage + editorial transcripts (avg doc size ~18k tokens, distribution long tail up to 120k tokens).
- Primary goal: replace legacy keyword search with RAG-backed semantic search + learned reranker for precision on long queries.
- KPIs: mean end-to-end latency <= 300ms for 95% of queries (aim p50 ~120ms), cost per query target <= $0.06, retrieval MRR/NDCG uplift vs current TF-IDF baseline.

Technical constraints / scale:
- Index target: 8-12M documents after chunking (source objects ~1.1M).
- Chunking strategy under consideration: 3 variants to test in POC:
  1) paragraph-level chunks (~512-1024 tokens) with 25% overlap (better context but larger index).
  2) sliding-window long-chunks (~2048 tokens) w/ 50% overlap for transcripts (reduces RAG candidates count).
  3) hybrid: metadata-first (headline + timestamp) + content chunks for long-form; add synthetic 'section' embeddings for narrative segmentation.
- Working hypothesis: hybrid reduces candidates scored by reranker by ~40% while preserving recall.

Embeddings / vector DB choices:
- Prefer open models (instruction-tuned embedding variants) for cost control, but willing to test Redwood-verified high-dim vectors for reranker pairing.
- Considering vector stores: dedicated GPU-backed ANN (FAISS on Dedicated) vs Pinecone for hosted experiment. Need cost/perf numbers for both.

Reranker tuning notes (from 2024-12-02 workshop):
- Initial reranker: lightweight cross-encoder (distilBERT variant) trained on QuillStream relevance labels (20k manually labeled pairs) + synthetic negatives.
- Tuning knobs discussed: pairwise vs pointwise loss, margin hyperparam, hard-negative mining cadence, candidate pool size (topK from vector store), temperature for soft-labels.
- Operational tradeoffs: larger cross-encoders improve NDCG but add 40-120ms per-query if run serially. Need to evaluate batching + GPU inference (Dedicated) to keep reranker time under 120ms per query at target throughput.
- Proposal: run reranker on a candidate set of top-12, use early-exit thresholding, and a cheap teacher model for initial scoring to prune to top-6.

POC plan / timeline (agreed on call):
- Week 0 (Dec wk1): deliver scrubbed sample (200k source docs) -> QuillStream.
- Week 1-2: ingest, test three chunking strategies, index to FAISS on Dedicated POC cluster.
- Week 3: run vector + reranker experiments: measure recall@10, MRR, NDCG, end-to-end latency distribution, GPU utilization, cost per 10k queries.
- Week 4: performance tuning: batching, KV cache settings, quantization profiles.
- Deliverable: POC report + config recommendations for Dedicated vs Private deploy; cost projection for 10M indexed chunks.
